rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a physically or generally uncomfortable way.

example.english: I walked in these shoes and felt uncomfortably uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 我着住呢對鞋行路，成個人唔舒服咁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoek3 zyu6 ni1 deoi3 haai4 haang4 lou6 seng4 go3 jan4 m4 syu1 fuk6 gam3

rows.note: Use this when the discomfort is mainly emotional, social, or a feeling of unease rather than physical pain.

example.english: I sat there uncomfortably when I met my girlfriend’s family for the first time.
example.traditional: 第一次見女朋友屋企人，我唔自在咁坐喺度，成晚都唔知講乜好。
example.jyutping: dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2 jan4 ngo5 m4 zi6 zoi6 gam3 co5 hai2 dou6 seng4 maan5 dou1 m4 zi1 gong2 mat1 hou2
